ValidationRule.description: Validate observed HTTP status, nonnegative duration, and attempt ordinals without inventing values for unknown callbacks.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Http_Status__c)), OR(Http_Status__c < 100, Http_Status__c > 599)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_Ms__c)), Duration_Ms__c < 0), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Attempt_Number__c)), Attempt_Number__c < 1))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: HTTP status must be 100-599, duration cannot be negative, and attempt number must be positive.
